def _measure_side_brep_generators(shape, record, controls, roots,
                                  E_bottom_center, E_depth_center,
                                  coordinate_tolerance_mm=1e-5,
                                  coverage_tolerance_mm=1e-3,
                                  straightness_tolerance_mm=1e-5):
    """Measure actual fused-BRep A/B longitudinal boundaries against the shared rails."""
    half_width = max(abs(float(controls[0]["v_mm"])),
                     abs(float(controls[-1]["v_mm"])))
    S = np.asarray(record["S"], dtype=float)
    U = np.asarray(record["unit"], dtype=float)
    W = np.asarray(record["width_axis"], dtype=float)
    results = []
    for side, fiber_index in (("A", 0), ("B", len(controls) - 1)):
        edge = controls[fiber_index]
        root = roots[fiber_index]
        q_i, q_e, q_r = (float(edge["q_front_mm"]), float(edge["q_E_mm"]),
                         float(root["q_root_mm"]))
        expected_v = -half_width if side == "A" else half_width
        expected_ranges = {
            "tail_R_to_I": (q_r, q_i),
            "outer_I_to_E": (q_i, q_e),
        }
        intervals = {name: [] for name in expected_ranges}
        residuals = {name: [] for name in expected_ranges}
        geom_types = {name: [] for name in expected_ranges}
        for brep_edge in shape.Edges():
            vertices = brep_edge.Vertices()
            if len(vertices) != 2:
                continue
            endpoint_coords = []
            for vertex in vertices:
                xyz = np.asarray(vertex.Center().toTuple(), dtype=float)
                delta = xyz[:2] - S
                q = float(np.dot(delta, U))
                v = float(np.dot(delta, W))
                endpoint_coords.append((q, v, xyz))
            if any(abs(v - expected_v) > coordinate_tolerance_mm
                   for _, v, _ in endpoint_coords):
                continue
            qa, qb = endpoint_coords[0][0], endpoint_coords[1][0]
            if abs(qb - qa) < 1.0:
                continue
            region = next((name for name, q_range in expected_ranges.items()
                           if min(qa, qb) >= min(q_range) - 1.0 and
                           max(qa, qb) <= max(q_range) + 1.0), None)
            if region is None:
                continue
            intervals[region].append((min(qa, qb), max(qa, qb)))
            geom_types[region].append(str(brep_edge.geomType()))
            for fraction in (0.0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0):
                point = np.asarray(brep_edge.positionAt(fraction).toTuple(), dtype=float)
                delta = point[:2] - S
                q = float(np.dot(delta, U))
                v = float(np.dot(delta, W))
                if region == "tail_R_to_I":
                    bottom = tail_bottom_line(q, edge, root)
                    top = linear_value_at(q, q_r, float(edge["R_top_z_mm"]),
                                          q_i, float(edge["I_upper_z_mm"]))
                else:
                    bottom = bottom_outer_line(record, edge, q, v, E_bottom_center)
                    top = top_motherline(record, edge, float(edge["dI_world_Z_mm"]), q, v,
                                         E_bottom_center, E_depth_center)
                expected_xy = xy_at_q(record, q, v)
                xy_error = float(np.linalg.norm(point[:2] - np.asarray(expected_xy, dtype=float)))
                z_error = min(abs(float(point[2]) - float(bottom)),
                              abs(float(point[2]) - float(top)))
                residuals[region].append(max(xy_error, z_error))

        region_results = {}
        for region, q_range in expected_ranges.items():
            merged = []
            for lower, upper in sorted(intervals[region]):
                if not merged or lower > merged[-1][1] + coverage_tolerance_mm:
                    merged.append([lower, upper])
                else:
                    merged[-1][1] = max(merged[-1][1], upper)
            expected_length = abs(float(q_range[1]) - float(q_range[0]))
            covered_length = float(sum(upper - lower for lower, upper in merged))
            endpoint_error = (float(max(abs(merged[0][0] - min(q_range)),
                                        abs(merged[-1][1] - max(q_range)))) if merged else None)
            residual_max = float(max(residuals[region])) if residuals[region] else None
            region_results[region] = {
                "expected_q_range_mm": [float(min(q_range)), float(max(q_range))],
                "merged_brep_edge_q_ranges_mm": merged,
                "covered_length_mm": covered_length,
                "expected_length_mm": expected_length,
                "endpoint_coverage_error_mm": endpoint_error,
                "candidate_edge_count": len(intervals[region]),
                "brep_geom_types": sorted(set(geom_types[region])),
                "max_residual_to_straight_shared_rail_mm": residual_max,
                "coverage_pass": bool(endpoint_error is not None and
                                       endpoint_error <= coverage_tolerance_mm and
                                       abs(covered_length - expected_length) <= coverage_tolerance_mm),
                "straightness_pass": bool(residual_max is not None and
                                           residual_max <= straightness_tolerance_mm),
            }
        valid = all(item["coverage_pass"] and item["straightness_pass"]
                    for item in region_results.values())
        results.append({"side": side, "v_mm": float(expected_v),
                        "regions": region_results, "valid": bool(valid)})
    return results
